title: Combine physical simulation and mixing in each fixed polynomial-volume regime
statement: For any FIXED q>=0, restrict V<=(1+B+epsilon^-1)^q in the fixed conservative spatial model. Compare binary T with the accepted computable polynomial-nV mixing threshold. Beyond it use the accepted equilibrium sampler with an allocated TV budget. Before it, numerical T, the maximum original-clock exit rate and a bounded uniformization event cap are polynomial in B+epsilon^-1. A bounded Poisson-mixture sampler and bounded categorical transition sampling therefore give unconditional entire-TV accuracy and every-run polynomial work, RAM and randomness; fallback states are valid and all paths use original enabled transitions. The polynomial exponent may depend on fixed q and Theta. This is NOT a complete-binary polynomial when epsilon^-1 itself is exponential, nor an arbitrary-volume all-time theorem.
